title: In This City, Every Lie Makes You Shorter

endCard.cta: Follow for the next strange city.

sources: Reine Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire, Format 'In this city' + trockener Erzähler, Marktanalyse 20.11.2026 in docs/berichte/markt-2026-11-20.md, Video 2). Keine Tatsachenbehauptung; keine Marken, keine fremden Figuren.
pointe: Dave besteht Pullover, Auflauf und 'Liebst du meine Tochter?' ehrlich – und schrumpft bei der Höflichkeitslüge 'I'd love to' (jeden Sonntag). Er landet neben dem 2-Zoll-Vater: 'Welcome to the family.' Letzte Zeile an die Zuschauer: 'Did you like this video? Careful how you answer.'
originality: Eigene Regel (jede Lüge = 1 Zoll kleiner), eigene Figuren (Dave, Mia, Linda, der Salzstreuer-Vater). Keine Lügen-Nase (Fremdfigur gemieden); keine der belegten Trend-Regeln (Zeit, Erinnerung, Wörter, Zahl über dem Kopf) und keine früheren KnowToon-Regeln (Gähnen, Tor, Schwerkraft).

music.why: Peinlicher Familien-Sitcom-Moment → 'funny' (bouncy R&B-Pop), Seed = Episoden-ID (anders als Gähn-Stadt), 92 BPM etwas schleichender für die Dinner-Spannung; Stille vor 'Poof' und vor der Schlusszeile. Sound-Trends: Ich kann das nicht bestätigen (keine belegten Daten).

narratorMood.mood: trocken (deadpan), ernst über das Absurde, Dialoge leicht gespielt, Höhepunkt angespannt, Schluss flach und leise
narratorMood.why: Gleiche Machart wie Gähn-Stadt (ernster Erzähler + absurde Folge); voicePreset 'witzig' + ironic/playful; Satzenden stärker abgesenkt (end_db 7, Fenster 0,7 s) wegen Gähn-Audit 'Satzende kaum leiser'.

style.why: Gleicher 2D-Cartoon wie Gähn-Stadt (Schauspiel, Farbe, schnelle Renderzeit); Schrumpfen ist in 2D als reine Skalierung + Poof sofort lesbar. Neu: Arme mit Ellenbogen und Gesten (Gähn-Audit 'Arme steif').
style.characters: DAVE: sehr groß, orange Hoodie, braune Locken; MIA: pinkes Kleid, Pferdeschwanz; LINDA (Mutter): riesiger gelber Strickpulli mit schielendem Katzengesicht, rote Lockenfrisur; DAD: 2 Zoll groß, Schnurrbart, blaues Hemd; Hintergründe hell-pastell, Figuren gesättigt.

hookQuestion.text: Can Dave survive one dinner without telling a lie?
hookQuestion.shownBy: Bild 1: Angler schrumpft bei 'THIS big'; Frage gesprochen in stakes (~17 s: 'How hard can it be?')
hookQuestion.answer: Fast – bei der Höflichkeitslüge 'I'd love to' schrumpft er (56 s).

finalImage.image: Mini-Dave + Mini-Dad auf dem Salzstreuer, Blick in die Kamera, Maßband

scenes.text: In this city, every lie makes you *shorter*. | One lie, | one *inch*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, COVER 0–0,5 s): pier; a fisherman holds his arms wide 'THIS big' while a tiny fish dangles from his rod – POOF, he shrinks a notch against a height chart painted on the bait shack / SHOT 2 (low, 'One lie'): he is now knee-high, the tiny fish on the planks is as big as his head and stares at him / SHOT 3 (ECU, 'inch'): a tape measure snaps back one inch with a plink
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: So car salesmen are *ankle-high*. | Dating profiles are *brutally* honest. | And every fisherman lives in a *birdhouse*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (wide, car lot): an ankle-high salesman in a suit stands on a car tyre, shouting up at a customer / SHOT 2 (medium, café): a woman looks down from her chair; her date is a tiny man standing on the sugar bowl, phone profile behind him says 6'2" crossed out / SHOT 3 (wide, tree): a birdhouse on a pole, a thumb-sized fisherman waves from the round door, rod sticking out
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: This is Dave. | Six foot four. | Dave has never told a single lie. | Not even to his *boss*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (low, hallway): Dave in an orange hoodie ducks under a doorframe and bonks his head anyway / SHOT 2 (medium, office): Dave towers over a tiny boss on the desk and says the meeting could have been an email, boss fumes
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Tonight, he meets his girlfriend's *mother*. | She *cooked*. | One dinner. | No lies. | How hard can it be?
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, porch at dusk): Dave and Mia (pink dress) at a front door, Dave adjusts his collar, rings the bell / SHOT 2 (ECU, kitchen): a pot of grey sludge bubbles; a single eye in the sludge opens
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Question one. | "Do you like my sweater?" | Dave looks. | "It's very… *brave*."
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, doorway): the mother (Linda) opens the door in a huge knitted sweater with a cross-eyed cat face, beaming / SHOT 2 (close, Dave): Dave stares at the sweater, eye twitch, sweat / SHOT 3 (two-shot): Dave stays exactly the same height; Linda's eyebrow goes up
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Then the casserole. | It's grey. | It *bubbles*. | Something in it *blinks*. | "Is it good?" | Dave chews. | "I've never tasted anything like it." | Technically, *true*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (top, table): Linda sets down a grey casserole that bubbles; one eye in it blinks / SHOT 2 (close, Dave): Dave chews slowly, cheeks full, eyes watering / SHOT 3 (two-shot): Linda squints, leaning in; Dave still full height
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Then Dave notices the dad. | Two inches tall. | Sitting on the *salt shaker*. | Thirty years of "Yes, dear. | *Delicious*."
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, table): Dave looks down at the table, confused / SHOT 2 (macro, salt shaker): a two-inch dad with a moustache sits on the salt shaker, eating a single grain of rice with a toothpick fork, gives a weary nod / SHOT 3 (flashback, sepia wedding photo row): the dad shrinking photo by photo, each with a plate
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: Then Linda leans in. | "Do you *love* my daughter?" | "Yes." | Still tall. | "Then you'll come *every* Sunday?" | Dave smiles. | "I'd *love* to."
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (ECU, Linda): Linda leans into camera, eyes narrow / SHOT 2 (close, Dave + Mia): 'Yes' – Mia beams, hearts; Dave still tall / SHOT 3 (ECU, Linda): 'every Sunday' – calendar on the wall behind her with every Sunday circled in red / SHOT 4 (close, Dave): forced huge grin, sweat
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: *Poof*. | Dave lands next to Dad. | Dad hands him a tiny fork. | "Welcome to the *family*."
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (medium, table): POOF cloud, Dave's chair suddenly empty, hoodie flutters down / SHOT 2 (macro, salt shaker): two-inch Dave lands next to Dad, both tiny; Dad hands him a toothpick fork, pats his back; giant Linda smiles in the background
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

scenes.text: So… | did you like this video? | Careful how you *answer*.
scenes.visual: SHOT 1 (close, to camera): tiny Dad and tiny Dave on the salt shaker look straight into the lens; Dad slowly raises an eyebrow and holds up a tape measure
sources: Fiktion (Welt-Regel-Satire): Stadt, Lügen-Regel, Dave, Mia, ihre Eltern sind erfunden – keine Tatsachenbehauptung.

note: 167 Skriptwörter, 10 Szenen, Ziel 63–68 s inkl. End-Card.

soundBed.why: Ort-Ambient leise, Basstreffer vor den Enthüllungen (Schrumpfen im Hook, Vater-Reveal, Poof), Ausklang über End-Card.
